acceptance_met: Every batch is validated for framing (exact declared lengths, v2 magic, sequential offset deltas, declared record lengths), CRC32C (Castagnoli, attributes-to-end), record count (numRecords/lastOffsetDelta plus exact record walk) and per-(producer,topic,partition) base-sequence continuity with broker-faithful retry dedup; offsets are assigned monotonically per partition (client-stated base ignored like the in-repo mock and real brokers: partitionline always sends 0). Violations return INVALID_RECORD / OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE_NUMBER / INVALID_TXN_STATE and are counted per cause.

Single node, N partitions (default 6, --partitions), plaintext; speaks ApiVersions v0-v4, Metadata v13, Produce v12, InitProducerId v5 and FindCoordinator v6 (required by Producer::new, implemented though the produce path never sends it). No peer-compat, multi-node or fault modes (KL09-66/KL09-08).

Server-side accepted records/wire-bytes and per-cause failures go to a JSON artifact labeled client-ceiling (atomic tmp+rename); nullbroker is workspace-excluded with zero dependencies and no reference from partitionline (only the workspace exclude line).
commands: cargo test --locked --manifest-path benchmarks/nullbroker/Cargo.toml (15 unit + 2 interop passed)
bench_produce COUNT=200000 vs nullbroker: acked 200000 at 1279328 rec/s; IDEMPOTENT=1 COUNT=50000: acked 50000 at 539200 rec/s; artifact accepted_records 250000, failures all zero
limits: Compressed batches get framing+CRC+count-header checks only; record contents are opaque without a codec (trusted header count).
Request-header v2 keeps the classic client id (found live: partitionline sends i16 client id on ApiVersions v4); unknown API keys and unspoken versions close the connection.
Idempotent dedup remembers only the last committed batch per (producer,topic,partition); full history (mock-style) is KL09-08 scope.
Informational ceiling numbers only (pre-KL09-02 driver, loopback, n=1); not a claim, per the KL09-01 freeze.
